# autocraw

> autocraw (@zhadev/autocraw, CLI: zac) is a Node.js 22+ site intelligence crawler. It scrapes pages to LLM-ready Markdown, maps and crawls sites, batch scrapes, extracts structured JSON with an AI model, runs browser actions and screenshots, and analyzes how a site is built (tech stack, SSR/RSC/CSR, hydration traps, URL patterns, pagination, search, filters, media sources, WordPress AnimeStream and Madara templates). It ships a CLI, a TypeScript library and a local REST API. License: GPL-3.0-only.
